NGA.note: No link between civil register and ID system is stated.

facts.fact: Biometric Update quotes NIMC's Director General that biometrics of more than 115 million Nigerians have been captured in enrolment, about 48% of the 237.5 million population (share computed from the population given).

NGA.note: Only a school-feeding enrolment of children is stated, not a number at birth.
No operator or supplier is stated.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that NIMC says its multipurpose NIN-linked card will be linked to a farmer registry under a G2P programme, crucial for creating a farmer digital ID registry.
Biometric Update reports that NIMC is enrolling people for the NIN, with biometrics of more than 115 million captured, and is about to launch a three-in-one NIN-linked chip card.
